data.creative: Boy's burned-off-seven-times wart testimonial with dad · 4217474961875639
data.hook: I've had my warts burnt off seven times, nothing happened.
data.desire: Stop being embarrassed at school and get rid of warts without pain
data.angle: A kid who failed seven burn-off treatments says this small bottle worked with no pain
data.belief_shift: from 'warts keep coming back even after burning' → to 'a little bottle cleared them with no pain'
data.script_structure: Failed treatments (7 times) → school embarrassment → bottle show + applicator → one month result with foot photo → hands too → no pain (dad confirms) → 'unbelievable' → Shop Now end card
data.proof: Child testimonial, inset before/after foot photos at 0:11-0:14, parent confirmation 'no burning, no pain', bottle in hand.
data.cta: End card: 'Shop Now!' sticker with arrow on bottle close-up. Button: Shop Now to amoils.com/products/warts.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: A child stating 'seven times' gives a hard, believable failure count, and the school embarrassment makes it emotional. The dad stepping in to confirm 'no pain' adds an adult witness and speaks to the parent watching.
data.transferable_move: Open with a user stating an exact count of failed attempts, cut in a quick before/after insert, then bring in a second witness to confirm the main fear (pain) didn't happen. Soften: avoid 'gone' promises; say 'cleared up for us'.
data.opening_visual: Boy about 11 in a Cowboys rugby shirt against a white door, holding an applicator; caption 'I've had my warts burned off 7 times'.
data.transition_to_product: 0:07.8 'Just the little bottle right here' — boy holds the bottle up at 0:08.
data.proof_placement: Before/after foot photos follow the 'maybe a month' line; dad's no-pain confirmation follows the result claims.
